status: specification-only; no process, IPC or adversarial tests executed

scenarios.title: Concurrent host start
scenarios.action_or_fault: Race startup and writes through app, CLI and MCP.
scenarios.expected: One write authority, losers attach; no direct-store fallback.

scenarios.title: Suspended owner
scenarios.initial: Owner holds store and a pending command.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Suspend owner; let client time out; attempt takeover then resume owner.
scenarios.expected: Timeout cannot authorize another writer; no overlapping authority effects.

scenarios.title: Path alias
scenarios.initial: One store reachable through two paths.
scenarios.expected: Same store identity/ownership; alias cannot create second writer.

scenarios.title: Crash and lost outcome
scenarios.action_or_fault: Kill host, recover, retry same op and inspect outcome.
scenarios.expected: One effect; new generation; auth before receipt, dedup before stale guard.

scenarios.title: Provisional rejection
scenarios.initial: View has pending edits and authority rejects earlier base.
scenarios.expected: All input protected/mapped; no echo double insert or dropping later text.

scenarios.title: Last view and failed save
scenarios.action_or_fault: Close last view; fail save and recovery protection.
scenarios.expected: Cancel close/quit, preserve work; idle exit cannot lose content.

scenarios.title: Descriptor/endpoint substitution
scenarios.action_or_fault: Forge descriptor, foreign endpoint and stale generation.

scenarios.title: Grant and context forgery
scenarios.initial: Client only allowed Space A read.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Write A, read B, forge actor/context or internal ingest.
scenarios.expected: Denied before mutation/receipt leakage; no client-selected privilege.

scenarios.title: Revocation race
scenarios.initial: Active subscription and mutation pending admission.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Revoke grant while admitting command and reconnect stream.
scenarios.expected: Documented atomic admission result; no newly unauthorized admission/stream; committed effects are not erased.

scenarios.title: Framing and decode bounds
scenarios.action_or_fault: Send truncated, oversized, deep JSON, huge counts and invalid version frames.
scenarios.expected: Bounded failure before unsafe allocation/admission, no partial effect.

scenarios.title: Fairness and backpressure
scenarios.initial: Typing client shares host with flood client.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Exceed active and queue caps with repeated queries/mutations.
scenarios.expected: Bounded queues and actionable refusal/resync; typing/recovery not starved, accepted work accounted.

scenarios.title: Symlink race
scenarios.initial: Authorized import/output root and staged asset.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Swap path symlink/reparse target during validation/write.
scenarios.expected: Handle-safe containment prevents unauthorized reads/writes and preserves content.

scenarios.title: Malicious rich content
scenarios.action_or_fault: Submit scripts, unsafe URLs, decompression bombs and media metadata.
scenarios.expected: No code execution or incidental secret-bearing network fetch; bounded rejected/preserved payload.

scenarios.title: CLI/MCP channel parity
scenarios.initial: Equivalent scoped commands from both adapters.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Force validation, stale guard, pending outcome and cancellation.
scenarios.expected: Same semantic IDs/effects/errors; clean JSON/MCP stdout; no UI dependency.

scenarios.title: Headless lifecycle
scenarios.action_or_fault: Create note, wait local durability, exit all clients, restart host and sync once.
scenarios.expected: Outbox survives; scoped sync status honest; stopped core does not claim to ingest.

scenarios.title: Windows seam
scenarios.initial: Portable core and mock Windows ports.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Compile shared boundary plus case/Unicode/reserved-name path fixtures.
scenarios.expected: No macOS/DOM/provider import in core; no actual Windows support claim from mocks.

scenarios.title: Diagnostic privacy
scenarios.expected: Default logs/results contain no canary secrets; explicit authorized content results are separate.

scenarios.title: Budget pressure
scenarios.initial: Typical workload plus slow storage/full disk.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Run cap+1 cases, cancellation during durable commit and idle timer expiry.
scenarios.expected: No false rejection of possibly committed work, no unprotected idle shutdown, truthful OutcomeRef.
